guides.welcome.title: Welcome to Cyrodiil
guides.welcome.purpose: You play one person of this province among other players. These keys open what the server adds to the game.
guides.welcome.self: Your own actions: emotes, your horse, your lore card, the party.
guides.welcome.interact: Actions towards the player in front of you: trade, an introduction, a party, a roll. In front of a notice board, its notices.
guides.welcome.chat: The chat: speech heard nearby, /me for what your character does, /b for a word out of character.
guides.welcome.answer: Yes or no to an invitation at the top of the screen.
guides.welcome.menu: Your menu: your character, the commands, these guides and the language.
guides.welcome.lore: Your lore card. With Shift, the card of the player in front of you.
guides.welcome.talk: Traders, bankers, stablemasters and mentors open their windows from the topic "Services" in the game's dialogue.
guides.trader.title: The trader
guides.trader.purpose: Traders sell food, drinks, clothes, potions, tools, weapons, armour and books. They only sell.
guides.trader.step.1: Talk to a trader and pick the topic "Services". The shop opens when the talk ends.
guides.trader.step.2: Pick a kind of wares, then a ware and how many. The price comes out of the gold you carry.
guides.trader.step.3: The shop closes when you walk away from the trader.
guides.trader.step.4: The crosshair names every person of the server by what they do, so you know whom to ask.
guides.trader.fact.pieces: pieces in one purchase at most
guides.trader.fact.reach: away from the trader closes the shop
guides.bank.title: The bank
guides.bank.purpose: Gold at the bank stays yours through deaths and restarts, and nobody takes it from you on the road.
guides.bank.step.1: Talk to a banker and pick the topic "Services".
guides.bank.step.2: Type an amount, then deposit it or withdraw it. The chips fill in all you carry or all you keep at the bank.
guides.bank.step.3: The account belongs to your character. It costs nothing and pays no interest.
guides.stable.title: The stable
guides.stable.purpose: A stablemaster sells the game's five horses. One of them is yours, and only you ride it.
guides.stable.step.1: Talk to a stablemaster and pick the topic "Services". The price comes out of the gold you carry.
guides.stable.step.2: A new horse takes the place of the one you own, and nothing is paid back for it.
guides.stable.step.3: Call your horse from your own wheel, out in the open country. It does not come in a city or indoors.
guides.stable.step.4: Your horse leaves the world with you, and comes back whenever you call it.
guides.mentor.title: The mentor
guides.mentor.purpose: Your specialization decides how far your skills and attributes grow. A mentor teaches the three of a path, the Imperial Registrar all nine.
guides.mentor.step.1: The warrior's path: Knight, Barbarian, Ranger. The mage's: Wizard, Alchemist, Illusionist. The support's: Healer, Smith, Thief.
guides.mentor.step.2: What a specialization masters grows to 100. A skill it trains stops at {trained}, every other skill at {limited}.
guides.mentor.step.3: Until you choose, every skill stops at {unchosen}. Talk to a mentor and pick the topic "Services" to choose.
guides.mentor.step.4: A change costs gold and waits after the last choice. Skills above the new limits drop to them for good.
guides.foreman.title: The foreman
guides.foreman.purpose: Foremen run the work of the province: the lumber camp, the quarry and the docks.
guides.foreman.step.1: Talk to a foreman and pick the topic "Services".
guides.foreman.step.2: A foreman sells the tools of the work and buys what you bring from it, by the piece.
guides.foreman.step.3: On the docks, carry crates from an inlet to an outlet. The dock foreman pays wages for every crate.
guides.foreman.step.4: In the window the arrows pick, + and - set how many, and Enter makes the deal.
guides.notice_board.title: The notice board
guides.notice_board.purpose: Anyone can read the notices on a board and pin one. A notice is never signed.
guides.notice_board.step.1: Stand in front of a board and press H.
guides.notice_board.step.2: Write up to {length} letters and pin the notice.
guides.notice_board.step.3: Your own notices are marked, and you can take them down.
guides.notice_board.step.4: A full board takes its oldest notice down to make room for a new one.
guides.notice_board.fact.yours: notices of yours up at once
guides.gambling.title: The gaming table
guides.gambling.purpose: At a marked inn table two players play dice for gold. The server holds the stakes until the game ends.
guides.gambling.step.1: At the table, pick "Gaming table" on your own wheel, or face the other player and pick "Play dice".
guides.gambling.step.2: Pick the game and the stake. The other player answers the invitation with Y or N.
guides.gambling.step.3: Dice Poker: five dice, one raise a round, then a reroll of any dice. The first to win enough rounds takes the pot.
guides.gambling.step.4: Zenithar's Favor: two dice each, the higher total takes the pot.
guides.gambling.step.5: Esc only hides the window. The game goes on.
guides.gambling.fact.cut: the house's cut of the pot
guides.dice.title: The dice board
guides.dice.purpose: The board throws the dice the server rolls, and those around you read the result.
guides.dice.step.1: Throw with the mouse or the keys. Every die lands on the number the server rolled.
guides.dice.step.2: Up to {count} dice at once, of four kinds: d6, d10, d20 and d100.
guides.dice.step.4: Pick a dice set in the menu or with /dice. It is only a look.
guides.lore.title: The lore card
guides.lore.purpose: Your lore card tells who your character is. Strangers see only your race until you introduce yourself.
guides.lore.step.1: Fill in the fields from the lore list or in your own words, each Public or Private.
guides.lore.step.2: A trait is typed once, or rolled with 5d20 and one reroll. Then it stays as it is.
guides.lore.step.3: Introduce yourself from the wheel over a player. Once they say yes, they see your name.
guides.lore.step.4: Shift+End reads the card of the player in front of you.
guides.exchange.title: The trade
guides.exchange.purpose: Gold and items go from hand to hand in a window where both of you see both offers.
guides.exchange.step.1: Face the other player and pick Trade on their wheel. They answer with Y or N.
guides.exchange.step.2: Put in gold and items. Every change shows on both sides at once.
guides.exchange.step.3: Both confirm the offers as they stand. A change after that asks you both again.
guides.exchange.step.4: What you wear and what players made, such as their potions and enchanted items, stays out of a trade.
guides.exchange.fact.most: gold in one trade at most
